newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury plans board changes - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury plans board changes - paper.

text.p: Britain's J. Sainsbury group plans to create a separate board for its supermarket operation to sharpen management focus, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
Chairman David Sainsbury told the newspaper the group's strategy had not changed and that the move was designed to make the management team more accountable for its performance.
Dino Adriano would take up the post of group chief executive from next month and would also become chief executive of the new supermarket board, which would have around eight directors.
Sainsbury's DIY business Homebase and its operations in the United States would be run separately under David Bremner, the Financial Times said.
